featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of trying cakes from Hangout Cakes & More, and I must say, it was an unforgettable experience! This charming little bakery truly knows how to marry creativity with flavor, resulting in some of the most delicious cakes I’ve ever tasted.

Presentation:
From the moment I laid eyes on the cakes, I was captivated. Each cake was a work of art, beautifully designed with intricate details and vibrant colors. Whether it was the classic chocolate ganache or the trendy floral buttercream designs, the visual appeal alone made it difficult to choose!

Flavors:
Now, let’s talk about the taste! I opted for a slice of their signature red velvet cake and a piece of the rich chocolate mousse. The red velvet was moist with just the right amount of tanginess, complemented perfectly by the creamy cream cheese frosting that had a delightful hint of vanilla. The chocolate mousse, on the other hand, was a dream for any chocolate lover—smooth, decadent, and not overly sweet, it left me craving more.

Variety:
Hangout Cakes & More offers an impressive variety of flavors, catering to all palates. Whether you’re in the mood for fruity, nutty, or indulgently rich, you’re sure to find something that suits your taste. They also have options for dietary restrictions, including gluten-free and vegan cakes, which I truly appreciate.

Service:
The service at Hangout Cakes & More is exceptional. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and eager to help you choose the perfect cake for any occasion. They genuinely care about their customers and take the time to make personalized recommendations based on your preferences.

Overall Experience:
Overall, my experience at Hangout Cakes & More was delightful from start to finish. The combination of stunning designs, mouthwatering flavors, and exceptional service makes this bakery a must-visit. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply treating yourself, their cakes are sure to impress. I can't wait to return and try more flavors—highly recommend!

This sandwich activated my taste buds, its a perfect combination of chicken, lettuce, herbs and grilled bread. 😍

Tokyo mojito 😍

It's fizzy, lightly sweetened, minty lime and was refreshing.

Oreo Waffle 🍫

A classic delicious waffle with a chocolatey twist. This Oreo waffle for sure will make you come here for more.

AK 47 🍸
A Crunchy chocolate shake with creme and chocolate balls on it looked visually good and tasted delicious.

Kiwi Strawberry lemonade
😍
This is the best cooler I have tried till now a perfect blend of kiwi and strawberry with lemonade. Refreshing and perfect for summer!

Overall it was a great experience! Would definitely love to try more of the menu.

wanted to share some honest feedback about the cake I recently purchased from your shop. Unfortunately, it was quite disappointing and did not meet the expectations I had based on your usual reputation.

Firstly, the appearance of the cake was not up to standard. It looked rushed and uneven, with the icing roughly applied and decorations that seemed poorly done. I had requested a chocolate cake, but there was hardly any rich cocoa taste—it just felt overly sweet and artificial. The cream layers were minimal and uneven, which left parts of the cake tasting plain and dry.

I also noticed that the cream had a slightly grainy texture, and a few guests mentioned an odd aftertaste. Sadly, several slices were left unfinished, which almost never happens at our gatherings.

I understand that occasional mistakes happen, but given the price and the fact that this was for a celebration, I expected better quality and more care in both preparation and presentation.

I hope you take this feedback constructively. I’ve enjoyed your products in the past, which is why this experience was so surprising. I believe in supporting local businesses, and I truly hope this was just an off day. I’d appreciate a response and hope to see improvements in future orders

I ordered a custom cake for a special occasion, and not only did it look stunning, but it also tasted amazing. The staff was friendly, helpful, and made the whole process smooth from start to finish. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a cake that’s as beautiful as it is delicious!
Try their entire mango series… it’s the best in entire Bombay.

featured_reviews.name: Anju Ashokan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are absolutely delighted with the last-minute cake designed by Bonnie’s Bakery for our daughter’s 3rd birthday! From the design and appearance to the texture and flavor, everything was simply perfect. The cake was a hit with all our guests.... young and old alike ....and every bite was truly finger-licking good.....

The Dutch truffle, coated in smooth white milk chocolate, exceeded all our expectations. It was a delicious surprise that elevated our celebration to a whole new level❤️

Thank you for creating such a beautiful, royal,elegant, and incredibly tasty cake😋Your team’s talent and effort made our daughter’s birthday even more special.

With love:
Anju & Shivaprasad

featured_reviews.name: Tanisha Rasal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bonnie's Bakery: A Delightful Treat for All!

Bonnie's Bakery is a haven for foodies and health-conscious individuals alike! With a diverse selection of pastries, cupcakes, cakes, and quick snacks, there’s something to satisfy every craving. Whether you’re in the mood for a decadent dessert or a light bite, they’ve got you covered.

One of the standout features is their Guilt-Free Section, designed for those who prioritize a healthy lifestyle. It’s a rare find—a bakery where you can indulge without compromising your health goals.

The ambiance is equally remarkable. The decor is warm and inviting, and currently, they’ve gone all out with a stunning Christmas theme!

Whether you're celebrating, grabbing a quick snack, or simply treating yourself, Bonnie's Bakery offers an experience that's as delightful as their treats. Highly recommended! 🎄✨
